Willy Freeman, I'd completely -- well, see, Willy Freeman, he was going to Commerce High School, and he was a violin player, and he had what they call a -- they call them -- well, he just had a local band uptown. He lived up on -- oh, I don't know, 136th Street or 137th Street, someplace. And he used to have -- he used to get these local jobs, you know, and he had a set band that he'd play these local gigs with, and then he -- then when he met me, I met him when I was in high school, and he met me, so he…
Now, this was what, around 1926? Would that be right?
